title: Canonical internal scalar restriction and tensor comparison maps
statement: Let $a:\Lambda\to\Lambda'$ be a morphism of commutative condensed rings, $f:X\to Y$ a scheme morphism, and use the unbounded internal module derived categories, geometric adjunctions $L_{f,R}\dashv F_{f,R}$, exact scalar restriction $V_{a,T}$ and restricted regular coefficient $B_{a,T}$ of [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons]. Let $c_{R,f}:L_{f,R}\simeq D(f_R^*)$ be the canonical exact-left-derived comparison, and $\beta_{a,f}:D(f_{\Lambda'}^*)V_{a,X}\simeq V_{a,Y}D(f_\Lambda^*)$ the termwise scalar restriction/pullback isomorphism [def-sfb-derived-comap-upper-star-iso]. In apply-left-first order define $b_{a,f}:L_{f,\Lambda'}V_{a,X}\simeq V_{a,Y}L_{f,\Lambda}$ by $c_{\Lambda',f}V_{a,X}$, followed by $\beta_{a,f}$ and $V_{a,Y}c_{\Lambda,f}^{-1}$. Define $d_{a,f}:F_{f,\Lambda'}V_{a,Y}\to V_{a,X}F_{f,\Lambda}$ as the geometric right-adjunction mate of $b_{a,f}^{-1}$; invertibility is not asserted here. Define $v_{a,T}:V_{a,T}(\mathbf1_{\Lambda',T})\simeq B_{a,T}$ by the exact restriction/localization and degree-zero single-complex comparisons. Define $\rho_{a,f}:L_{f,\Lambda}B_{a,Y}\simeq B_{a,X}$ as $L_{f,\Lambda}(v_{a,Y}^{-1})$, then $b_{a,f}^{-1}$ at the new regular unit, then restriction of the canonical pullback unit isomorphism, then $v_{a,X}$. Finally, for $M,N\in D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_Y})$, define $\mu_{f,M,N}:L_{f,\Lambda}(M\otimes^{\mathbf L}N)\to L_{f,\Lambda}M\otimes^{\mathbf L}L_{f,\Lambda}N$ to be the specified internal derived tensor-pullback comparison [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom], written with the functor name $L$. These are the existing maps, with no additional flatness, boundedness or coefficient hypotheses.
